description: This PHP source file defines the PrepareBodyMiddleware class within the GuzzleHttp namespace. The class is responsible for preparing HTTP requests that contain a body by adding appropriate headers such as Content-Length, Content-Type, and Expect. It includes methods for processing requests to ensure correct headers are set based on request properties and options.

classes.name: PrepareBodyMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that prepares HTTP request bodies by adding appropriate headers such as Content-Length, Content-Type, and Expect before the request is sent.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the middleware with the next handler callable.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to process the request, adding headers based on request body properties and options.

methods.name: addExpectHeader
methods.description: Private method to determine whether to add the Expect header and set it accordingly based on request and options.
